newsitem.title: USA: Arco limits Line 63 shipments to 91.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Arco limits Line 63 shipments to 91.8 pct.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co said Tuesday it would limit March crude oil shipments on its Line 63 pipeline to 91.8 percent of the amount nominated by shippers, compared to no limitations last month.
The company said the March limit was based on daily throughput of 104,000 barrels per day, with most of the nominated crude coming from heavy grade fields.
Crude shipments on Line 63, which runs from San Joaquin Valley into Los Angeles, have been limited often since January 1994 when a major earthquake knocked out an older companion line.
